J03 · Necessary recovery and permission contract

PM J03-R01—08. Pending applicants cannot read chats; a real host approval starts a new interval. Leaving a seat does not leave the group; cancellation/end does not close the group. Only a current host can dissolve it. Read positions for visible messages and explicit notification read remain independent. Errors/unknown/409 use existing notice/toast/sheet patterns and retain allowed drafts. No @, mute or group push. External approval, dissolution and failures are reviewer preconditions, never self-permission product buttons.

roots.name: J04 · Review-only scenarios and state contract

nodes.text: Attendance is not a rating. Meal score (optional, 1–5 without default) is private and independent. Public reference and private reconnect use Save feedback but separate versions/dirty flags. First item unknown/failure/409 pauses the later item as Not saved yet; retry only unsaved items. OPEN revocation confirmation occurs before any batch write; cancelling saves nothing. Single-sided WAITING has no Open private chat or OPEN-withdraw promise. Expired self-service uses support; independent OPEN revoke remains available at any time. Support correction and other-person consent are external preconditions, never self-consent buttons.

nodes.name: No mealId, attendance prerequisite or seven-day window. again is Yes/No/null with no default; one answer OR one reason permits Save. Clear again retains reasons. Cancelling restores the latest confirmed version; first blank cancellation writes nothing. This storyboard demonstrates reason-only→saved→return/reopen→Yes update→clear again while preserving the reason. Other seven-value combinations and No use the same native chip component and PM rules; arbitrary input is not simulated. Save failure retains choices, unknown result checks the original request and never duplicates the person. Authorised staff visibility only; never derive a survey from reconnect or meal score.
